description: An address translation of the router, which applies whether or not any FirewallPolicy exists: masquerade or source NAT of connections that leave, destination NAT of connections that arrive.

interface.description: Interface the connections use, by name or glob, a glob being a prefix followed by `*`; excludes `zone`.

zone.description: FirewallZone whose interfaces the connections use; excludes `interface`.

destination.description: Destination address ranges of the connections; empty matches every destination.

destinationPorts.description: Destination ports, each a port or a range `<first>-<last>`, with `protocol`; empty matches every port.

protocol.description: Protocol of the connections; null matches every protocol.

source.description: Source address ranges of the connections; empty matches every source.

interface.description: Interface the connections use, by name or glob, a glob being a prefix followed by `*`; excludes `zone`.

zone.description: FirewallZone whose interfaces the connections use; excludes `interface`.

out.description: Where the connections leave, for `masquerade` and `snat`.

port.description: Port the rule translates to, with `match.protocol`; null keeps the port.

type.description: `masquerade` translates the source of a leaving connection to the address of the interface it leaves through, `snat` to `to.address`, and `dnat` the destination of an arriving connection to `to.address`.

title: NATRule

rules.description: masquerade and snat name out alone, dnat names in alone.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, !(s.type == "dnat" ? s["in"] != null && s.out == null : s.out != null && s["in"] == null))).map(n, "NATRule " + n).join(", ") + ": a masquerade or snat rule names out alone, a dnat rule in alone"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, s.type == "dnat" ? s["in"] != null && s.out == null : s.out != null && s["in"] == null))

rules.description: out and in name a zone or an interface, one of them.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, ![documents[n].spec.out, documents[n].spec["in"]].all(p, p == null || (p.zone == null) != (p.interface == null))).map(n, "NATRule " + n).join(", ") + ": out and in name a zone or an interface, one of them"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, [documents[n].spec.out, documents[n].spec["in"]].all(p, p == null || (p.zone == null) != (p.interface == null)))

rules.description: A NATRule's zone is a FirewallZone document.
rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(zones, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "FirewallZone" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].FirewallZone : {}), documents.filter(n, ![documents[n].spec.out, documents[n].spec["in"]].all(p, p == null || p.zone == null || p.zone in zones)).map(n, "NATRule " + n).join(", ") + " names a zone that no FirewallZone document declares")
rules.rule: cel.bind(zones, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "FirewallZone" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].FirewallZone : {}), documents.all(n, [documents[n].spec.out, documents[n].spec["in"]].all(p, p == null || p.zone == null || p.zone in zones)))

rules.description: A NATRule's interface is no VRF's device, which takes the VRF document's name; the output router-nftables also refuses a glob that matches devices alone.
rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(vrfs, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "VRF" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].VRF : {}), cel.bind(n, documents.filter(n, [documents[n].spec.out, documents[n].spec["in"]].exists(p, p != null && p.interface != null && p.interface in vrfs))[0], cel.bind(i, [documents[n].spec.out, documents[n].spec["in"]].filter(p, p != null && p.interface != null && p.interface in vrfs)[0].interface, "NATRule " + n + ": " + i + " is the device of VRF " + i + "; name the VRF's links or a zone of the VRF")))
rules.rule: cel.bind(vrfs, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "VRF" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].VRF : {}), documents.all(n, ![documents[n].spec.out, documents[n].spec["in"]].exists(p, p != null && p.interface != null && p.interface in vrfs)))

rules.description: snat and dnat give to, masquerade does not.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, (documents[n].spec.type == "masquerade") != (documents[n].spec.to == null)).map(n, "NATRule " + n).join(", ") + ": snat and dnat translate to the address of to, masquerade to that of the interface and has no to"

rules.description: A NATRule's addresses are of its family.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, !((s.match.source + s.match.destination).all(a, cidr(a).ip(0).family() == s.family) && (s.to == null || ip(s.to.address).family() == s.family)))).map(n, "NATRule " + n + " has addresses of another family than " + documents[n].spec.family).join("; ")
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, (s.match.source + s.match.destination).all(a, cidr(a).ip(0).family() == s.family) && (s.to == null || ip(s.to.address).family() == s.family)))

rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, s.match.protocol == null && (size(s.match.destinationPorts) > 0 || s.to != null && s.to.port != null))).map(n, "NATRule " + n).join(", ") + ": ports need match.protocol"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, s.match.protocol != null || size(s.match.destinationPorts) == 0 && (s.to == null || s.to.port == null)))
